pins.head: TWO ZONES, ONE ROOM
pins.sub: A Screen Instead of a Wall
pins.kicker: See how to split a studio
pins.title: Studio Apartment Zones: Split One Room Without Building Walls
pins.desc: A studio feels smaller when the bed is the first thing you see from the door. A folding screen behind the headboard and a round rug under the sofa do what a wall would do, and both come with you when the lease ends. Keep the desk near the window so the work zone gets the daylight. Contains affiliate links. #StudioApartment #SmallSpaceLiving #RoomDivider
pins.alt: A studio room with a bed in terracotta bedding behind a rattan folding screen on the left and a teal sofa with terracotta cushions on a round jute rug to the right, under a wall of windows with plants on the sill.

pins.head: BUY THE BIG BOTTLE ONCE
pins.title: Moisturizer Refills: Keep the Small Jar, Buy the Large Size
pins.desc: The small jar on the counter is the one you actually use, so there is no reason to keep buying it. Buy the large size or the pouch once, decant into the jar you like, and store the rest in a cupboard. The jar stays the same size and the cost per ounce drops. Contains affiliate links. #SkincareRefill #MoisturizerRoutine #BathroomCounter
pins.alt: A large plain refill pouch standing on a white bathroom counter beside an open glass jar of cream, with folded towels on the shelf behind.

pins.head: A SHELF THAT STRADDLES IT
pins.kicker: Store more in a small bathroom
pins.title: Small Bathroom Storage: Use the Space Above the Toilet Tank
pins.desc: The wall above the cistern is usually the only empty wall in a small bathroom, and a freestanding shelf unit stands on the floor around the toilet to reach it. Baskets on the lower shelf take the things you grab daily, folded towels go up top, and nothing goes into the tile. Contains affiliate links. #BathroomStorage #RenterFriendly #SmallBathroom
pins.alt: A white metal shelf unit standing over the toilet holding woven baskets and rolled white towels, with a wooden vanity and teal towel to the side.

pins.head: THE ROLL ENDS, THE DECAL STAYS
pins.title: Permanent or Removable Vinyl: Match the Type to the Surface
pins.desc: Removable vinyl is for the things you will change your mind about: a wall, a window, a rented fridge. Permanent is for anything washed or handled, like a mug or an outdoor sign. Buying one roll of each costs less than redoing a project in the wrong one. Contains affiliate links. #VinylCrafts #CricutProjects #CraftRoom
pins.alt: Two rolls of adhesive vinyl, one terracotta and one cream, lying on a pale wooden craft table beside a flat sheet of backing paper.

pins.head: REST IT, DO NOT LAY IT DOWN
pins.title: Full-Size Dual-Temperature Hot Glue Gun for Craft and Repair
pins.desc: A glue gun laid flat drips onto whatever is under it and the nozzle picks up dust. The wire stand folds out so the gun sits nose up between joins, and the dual temperature setting means the same gun handles foam on low and wood on high. Contains affiliate links. #HotGlueGun #CraftSupplies #DIYRepair
pins.alt: A cream hot glue gun resting on a wooden stand with glue sticks beside it, a squeeze bottle of craft glue and a roll of masking tape on a wooden workbench.

pins.head: LEAVE ROOM FOR YOUR ARMS
pins.title: Small Home Office: Leave the Front Edge of the Desk Empty
pins.desc: A small desk fills up from the front, and then there is nowhere to rest your arms while you type. Push the sorter and the pen tray to the back edge, put the laptop on a riser, and move the overflow into a basket under the desk. The depth you actually need is about forty centimetres. Contains affiliate links. #HomeOffice #DeskSetup #SmallSpaceLiving
pins.alt: A wooden desk by a window with a laptop on a monitor riser, a white file sorter and a pen tray at the back edge, a basket underneath and a teal chair.

pins.head: RINSE BEFORE THE PAINT SETS
pins.title: Paint Brush Care: Rinse Acrylic Out Before It Dries
pins.desc: Acrylic sets inside the bristles in minutes, and once it has, the brush keeps a shape it will never lose. Keep the jar within reach, rinse the moment you change colour, and wipe on a cloth rather than the rim. The reset at the end of a session is then just drying. Contains affiliate links. #BrushCare #AcrylicPainting #PaintStation
pins.alt: A wooden block holder with paint brushes standing bristles up, a clear glass jar and a folded grey cloth on a wooden table by a window.

pins.head: A CLEAR LID SAVES DIGGING
pins.title: Under-Bed Storage: Clear Boxes Beat Opaque Ones in a Small Bedroom
pins.desc: An opaque box under the bed becomes a place things go to be forgotten, because checking it means dragging it out and lifting the lid. A clear box with a fitted lid tells you what is inside from across the room, so the out-of-season layer you packed in April actually comes back out in October. Contains affiliate links. #SmallBedroom #UnderBedStorage #BedroomOrganization
pins.alt: A clear lidded storage box pulled out from under a bed with folded clothes stacked inside, beside a bed with a teal duvet and terracotta cushions, a wooden nightstand with a lamp and a clothes rail.

pins.head: WRITE IT ON THE PAGE
pins.title: Supplement Labels: Write Down the Three Things That Matter
pins.desc: Three lines are enough for each bottle: what it is, how much is in a serving, and the day you opened it. That page survives the label peeling off and answers the question a pharmacist asks without anyone hunting through a cupboard. Keep it with the bottles, not in a drawer somewhere else. Contains affiliate links. #SupplementRoutine #LabelReading #HouseholdEssentials
pins.alt: Two amber glass supplement bottles with gold lids on a light wooden counter beside an open notepad with a wooden pencil resting on the page, with a potted plant blurred behind.

pins.head: IT ALL MOVES OUT WITH YOU
pins.sub: A Rack, a Stand, a Console
pins.title: Renter Entryway Storage: Freestanding Pieces Only, No Drilling
pins.desc: A coat stand, a two-tier shoe rack and a narrow console do the whole job of an entryway without a single hole, and the over-door hook takes the coat that is still wet. A runner on the floor keeps the grit in one place. All of it moves out in an afternoon. Contains affiliate links. #RenterFriendly #EntrywayOrganization #NoDrilling
pins.alt: A wooden coat stand holding a tote bag beside a two-tier shoe rack of shoes and a narrow wooden console, with a terracotta raincoat on an over-door hook and a patterned runner on the floor.

pins.head: START WITH ONE POUND
pins.title: Unflavored Whey Isolate in a One-Pound Tub to Try First
pins.desc: A five-pound tub of the wrong protein is five pounds of regret. A one-pound tub is about fourteen servings, which is long enough to learn whether it mixes the way you want and short enough that finishing it is not a chore. Unflavored goes into coffee or oats without a fight. Contains affiliate links. #ProteinPowder #DailyNutrition #GroceryPlanning
pins.alt: A large cream tub of protein powder beside a clear shaker bottle with a grey lid and a folded towel on a wooden kitchen counter.

pins.head: THE COUNTER IS NOT A SHELF
pins.title: Small Kitchen Organization: Keep the Counter as Work Space
pins.desc: In a small kitchen the counter is the only place you can actually chop, so anything that lives there permanently costs you the job the kitchen is for. Move the jars and bowls onto an open shelf, hang the towel by the cooker, and keep one clear stretch of worktop free. Contains affiliate links. #SmallKitchen #KitchenOrganization #CounterSpace
pins.alt: A narrow galley kitchen with open shelves of stacked plates and mugs on the left, cream cabinets, and a white cooker with a red casserole pot on the hob beside a hanging net of oranges and a striped towel.
